name: Attending Under Protest
title: Men's Christmas – Attending Under Protest Socks
story: Attending under protest: Christmas socks for the dad who showed up to the family party in a Santa hat he did not choose, a stocking stuffer his wife or kids can wrap in two minutes.

The print is a grumpy reindeer in a Santa hat with its arms crossed, in red, sage and cream stitch-style art, over ATTENDING UNDER PROTEST in heavy slab capitals in red and black, on cream. The art matches our Attending Under Protest crewneck and hoodie, so the socks make a set with the sweatshirt.

Every family has one person who would rather be home on the couch and is there anyway, arms crossed and still wearing the hat. These socks say it for him without a word and fit under jeans or slippers. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy gift for the dad, grandpa or brother-in-law who already owns a tie with a reindeer on it.
joke_a: Every family party has one guest who came for the food and stayed for the exit. The Attending Under Protest Socks from Graphic Tees Co. print a grumpy reindeer with its arms crossed on the leg, so the joke reads at the holiday party and under the tree on Christmas morning.
ink: the red, black and cream print
